subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should upstream liveness become a generic public Session Catalog Plugin SDK contract now, and if so must that contract use opaque plugin-owned source identities and classification?
rationale: The branch expands a shipped external Plugin SDK and persisted state model, while the canonical issue still carries a product-decision signal; code review cannot safely choose the permanent extension boundary.

options.title: Approve a generic opaque seam
options.body: Replace the closed source-kind union and Claude-specific SDK exports with an opaque provider-owned contract, then repair lifecycle cleanup and prove upgrades.

options.title: Keep the seam bundled-private
options.body: Implement Claude and Codex monitoring behind internal bundled-plugin facades until a broader observer API is explicitly approved.

options.title: Pause for the observer design
options.body: Defer this branch and continue product/API design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/104804 before exposing a public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a generic opaque seam
recommendation.body: Replace the closed source-kind union and Claude-specific SDK exports with an opaque provider-owned contract, then repair lifecycle cleanup and prove upgrades.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the strongest merged feature history for the session-state and watcher foundation and authored the canonical observed-session proposal.
